description: This file contains functions for masking and unmasking parts of Markdown text, primarily using regular expressions to identify inline code, links, URLs, and placeholders, and replacing them with temporary markers for processing.

methods.name: maskMarkdown
methods.description: Masks inline Markdown elements such as code snippets and links with placeholders, updating the mapping and placeholders list.

methods.name: maskMatches
methods.description: Helper function that finds matches of a given regex in text and replaces them with placeholders, updating the mapping.

methods.name: maskLinkURLs
methods.description: Replaces URLs within Markdown links with placeholders, updating the mapping.

methods.name: unmaskMarkdown
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in text with their original Markdown elements from the mapping.

methods.name: validatePlaceholders
methods.description: Ensures all placeholders are present in the given text.
